added.title: Director, Engineering
added.description:
Campfire is building the AI-native ERP for modern finance teams, backed by a $65M Series B from Accel and Ribbit Capital. Our engineering org is ~30 people today and growing to ~100, and we're hiring Directors of Engineering to lead that scale-up. Each Director owns a segment of the org — roughly 25–40 engineers across 3–5 teams — and will report to the CTO alongside two peer Directors. This is a manager-of-managers role: you'll hire and develop engineering managers, shape team structure within your area, and own how your teams plan, ship, and operate.

Responsibilities

Own the org design for your area: team boundaries, charters, and staffing plans
Lead, coach, and hold accountable 3–5 engineering managers; develop first-time managers and grow future leaders from the IC ranks
Drive hiring for your teams: headcount planning, recruiting, interviewer training, and closing senior candidates
Run planning and delivery for your area: roadmap alignment with product, quarterly commitments, and predictable execution across teams
Uphold operational rigor expected of a financial-systems company: on-call, incident response, SLOs, and release practices that hold up to enterprise and audit scrutiny
Partner with peer Directors, security, and compliance on cross-cutting concerns — shared platform, SOC 2, enterprise security reviews, AI governance
Set and uphold engineering standards — code review, testing, observability, architecture decisions — across a Python/Django, PostgreSQL, Next.js, and AWS stack

Qualifications

10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years managing engineers and 2+ years managing managers
Led a group of 20+ engineers with multiple managers reporting to you, through a period of rapid growth
Built or operated systems where correctness and auditability are non-negotiable: fintech, accounting, payments, or ERP
Technically credible with senior ICs — able to review architecture and weigh in on data-model and infrastructure decisions
Comfortable operating as one of several peer leaders: collaborative, low-ego, and effective at working across org boundaries
Hands-on interest in running LLMs and agents in production
Clear, direct communicator who writes well and gives hard feedback kindly

Bonus

Experience taking a product through enterprise security and compliance (SOC 2, SSO/SAML, vendor reviews)
Familiarity with revenue recognition, GAAP close, or accounting integrations (Stripe, Deel, Rippling, banks, payroll)
Experience with MCP or building integrations for AI platforms
Depth in Python and relational databases

added.title: Senior Engineering Manager – Firestorm OS
added.description:
Who We Are

At Firestorm, we are building the future of expeditionary defense manufacturing and autonomous systems. Modern conflict has exposed a fundamental problem: the systems needed most by operators are often too expensive, too slow to produce, and too difficult to sustain at scale. Firestorm exists to change that.

We develop mission-adaptable aerial systems and deployable manufacturing infrastructure designed to put capability directly into the hands of the warfighter. From modular unmanned aircraft to xCell — our deployable microfactory — our goal is to make defense systems rapidly deployable, adaptable, and producible at the point of need.

We are looking for builders, operators, and problem-solvers who want to work on meaningful technology with real-world impact.

About The Role

Firestorm builds modular autonomous aircraft designed to adapt across missions, payloads, and deployment environments.

Firestorm OS is the common software platform that enables those aircraft. It provides the Linux-based services, communications, media, hardware interfaces, SDKs, and system capabilities used across Firestorm aircraft and their variants.

As the aircraft portfolio grows, Firestorm OS has to remain reusable across different sensors, payloads, radios, propulsion systems, and compute platforms while providing stable interfaces to autonomy and application software.

We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Firestorm OS team. You will own the team, technical direction, and execution of the platform while remaining close to the architecture and software. You will work across autonomy, avionics, electrical, mechanical, and systems engineering to build an OS platform that evolves Firestorm’s aircraft portfolio.

What You’ll Do

Lead Firestorm OS — Own the team responsible for the common software platform across Firestorm aircraft.
Drive platform architecture — Define system boundaries, interfaces, services, and abstractions that allow Firestorm OS to support multiple aircraft and hardware configurations.
Build reusable aircraft software — Lead development of Linux services, communications, media, radios, SDKs, hardware interfaces, and other shared platform capabilities.
Drive platform execution — Turn aircraft and product needs into clear priorities, technical work, and reliable software releases.
Own cross-system integration — Work with autonomy, avionics, payload, electrical, and systems teams to integrate new hardware and capabilities without creating one-off solutions.
Set the engineering bar — Establish strong practices for design, testing, code review, diagnostics, packaging, deployment, and release.
Debug the full system — Lead resolution of difficult problems that cross application software, Linux, networking, hardware, and aircraft interfaces.
Grow the team — Hire, develop, and lead engineers with strong embedded Linux and systems software fundamentals.

Required Qualifications

8+ years building and shipping embedded, systems, or Linux-based software
3+ years leading software engineering teams with responsibility for people, execution, and delivery
Strong C or C++ experience and deep embedded Linux fundamentals
Experience designing software platforms, APIs, or shared services used across multiple products or systems
Experience developing Linux applications, system services, networking, and software that interfaces with hardware
Experience integrating software across complex hardware and software boundaries
Strong understanding of reliability, debugging, testing, and release practices for deployed systems
Demonstrated ability to make technical tradeoffs and drive ambiguous system problems from architecture through delivery
Strong written and verbal communication across software and hardware engineering teams
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building software for autonomous systems, robotics, aircraft, or other complex embedded products
Experience with vehicle or robotics interfaces such as MAVLink, PX4, ArduPilot, or similar platforms
Experience building SDKs, hardware abstraction layers, or platform APIs for other engineering teams

Work Environment

This role is based in San Diego, CA.
We welcome candidates who are local or open to relocating; relocation assistance is available and may be included in the offer package where appropriate.

Compensation

US Salary Range: $175,000 – $220,000 USD

The posted salary range reflects an estimate based on a variety of compensation factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, education, certifications, specialized skills, geographic location, and business needs. Actual compensation may vary, and this range is subject to change as our compensation structure or market conditions evolve.

Benefits & Perks

Our culture fosters collaboration, respect, and trust, empowering passionate people to do their best work. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career growth. In addition to an opportunity to take part in an innovative, collaborative and fast-growing business with a highly motivated and skilled team, we also take pride in taking care of our employees. Here are just a few ways that we show our appreciation:

We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and visions plans
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan to invest in your long-term retirement goals
Equity grants for new hires
Unlimited PTO
Extremely generous company holiday calendar, including a holiday hiatus in July & December.
Generous Parental Leave
Lifestyle Spending Account
FSA
DCFSA
HSA
Hospital Indemnity insurance
Critical Illness insurance
Accident insurance
Basic Life/AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, 100% covered by Firestorm. Plus, the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your family.
Mental Health Resources: We provide free mental health resources 24/7 including therapy and more. Additional work-life services, such as free legal and financial support, are available to you as well.

Export Control Compliance

To conform to U.S. government export control regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or otherwise eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Firestorm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and upholding equitable hiring practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic under federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process.

Firestorm is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require accommodations or assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at careers@launchfirestorm.com so we can provide the support you need.

added.title: Head of Restaurant Technology
added.description:
The Head of Restaurant Technology is responsible for the end-to-end ownership of all technology systems, connected devices, and digital infrastructure across Concessions International's restaurant footprint. Reporting directly to the CITO, this leader will define and execute a forward-looking restaurant technology strategy that elevates guest experience, enables operational efficiency, and supports the company's growth across airports and hospitality venues.

This role is fundamentally about guest experience whereby using technology as a lever to make every dining moment faster, smarter, and more memorable. Whether a traveler has 10 minutes before boarding or an hour to spare, this leader will ensure the technology powering that experience is seamless, reliable, and always improving. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves to troubleshoot a POS outage or triaging degraded network connectivity at a unit.

Technology Strategy & Innovation

Define and own the multi-year restaurant technology roadmap aligned to CI's operational and revenue growth goals
Champion a culture of innovation, continuously scanning the food & beverage, hospitality and retail tech landscape for ideas that meaningfully improve the dining experience
Serve as technology advisor to operations leadership for all restaurant and concessions locations
Identify and pilot emerging technologies such as AI-driven ordering, personalization engines, IoT kitchen monitoring, predictive inventory, and contactless payment that deliver competitive advantage in the airport dining environment
Translate guest experience goals into technology requirements: faster ordering, reduced wait times, smarter upsell, and frictionless payment
Build an innovation pipeline with clear evaluation criteria: guest impact, operational feasibility, and ROI

Guest Experience & Dining Innovation

Own the guest-facing technology experience across all CI locations from digital menu boards and self-service kiosks to mobile ordering and integrations
Use guest feedback, transaction data, and operational analytics to continuously improve the technology experience and identify friction points
Drive adoption of technology that increases average check, improves throughput, and creates memorable dining moments
Lead planning, deployment, and rollout of all restaurant-facing technology systems, POS, KDS, digital menu boards, self-service kiosks, payment processing, and other platforms
Own the full lifecycle of connected devices across all locations from procurement and provisioning to decommission
Establish repeatable implementation playbooks and standards for new location openings and remodels
Ensure all deployments meet security, compliance, and network standards in coordination with the broader IT team
Drive integration between restaurant systems and enterprise platforms (ERP, workforce management, finance)

Operations & Support

Own the technology support model for all restaurant locations in partnership with MSP’s and IT Operations team
Build and lead a high-performing restaurant technology team including engineers, support analysts, and project coordinators
Establish monitoring and alerting practices to proactively detect and resolve system issues before they impact operations
Partner with operations leadership to define technology-related KPIs (uptime, transaction speed, device availability)
Drive a continuous improvement culture regularly soliciting feedback from operations leaders and translating it into system improvements

Vendor & Partner Management

Own all vendor relationships for restaurant technology, POS providers, hardware OEMs, payment processors, and integration partners
Lead contract negotiations, renewal cycles, and SLA governance for all restaurant technology vendors
Manage vendor performance scorecards and escalate underperformance proactively
Evaluate and onboard new technology partners that align with CI's operational direction

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field. Master’s degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, with at least 3 years in restaurant, food & beverage, hospitality, or retail technology
Demonstrated ownership of POS platforms at scale (Oracle MICROS, Toast, NCR Aloha, PAX, or equivalent)
Experience managing technology across 20+ locations in a multi-site or franchise environment
Proven track record of end-to-end technology delivery: strategy through implementation through support
Strong vendor management experience including contract negotiation and SLA governance
Experience leading cross-functional teams and building technology organization

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in airport, travel retail, or high-throughput food service environments
Familiarity with concessions, quick service restaurant (QSR), or fast casual technology models
Exposure to AI-powered ordering, predictive inventory, or self-service kiosk deployments

Technical Competencies

POS & Kitchen Systems: POS platforms, KDS, order management, digital menu boards
Payments & Compliance: EMV, NFC/contactless, PCI-DSS, payment gateway integrations
Connected Devices & IoT: Network-connected device management, MDM/RMM platforms, IoT sensors
Networking: Retail/hospitality-grade LAN/WAN, wireless infrastructure, SD-WAN
Integrations: API-based integration between restaurant and enterprise systems (ERP, labor, loyalty)
Data & Analytics: Operational dashboards, transaction analytics, reporting infrastructure

added.description:
International R&D Team | Up to 40% profit participation | Remote
⚠️ Mandatory requirement: Advanced/fluent Italian (written and spoken). If you do not read Italian, please do not apply — you will not be able to proceed past screening.

NewtonThrust è un’infrastruttura di business internazionale già operativa e validata, progettata per scalare operazioni ad alto valore economico su mercati globali e settori complessi, con processi tecnologici e commerciali già implementati su roadmap di sviluppo strutturate. Il lancio ufficiale è programmato nel mese di novembre '26.

L’accesso al Team R&D rappresenta una partecipazione diretta a un modello di creazione di valore che redistribuisce fino al 40% dell’utile netto generato dall’intero volume d’affari.

Non si tratta di una posizione retribuita tradizionale, né di un modello consulenziale o orario.

È un’infrastruttura di partecipazione economica diretta, riservata a profili senior in grado di incidere su crescita, performance e scalabilità del sistema.

Chi stiamo cercando:

Chief Technology Officer (CTO) – USA (Global Role) - Impegno Minimo 4 ore al giorno (20h settimana), flessibilità totale basata su risultati e KPI misurabili

1. Responsabilità:

- Definire e governare la strategia tecnologica globale di NewtonThrust, assicurando coerenza architetturale, scalabilità e performance dell’intero ecosistema software.
- Operare come CTO di riferimento negli Stati Uniti, interfacciandosi in modo strutturato e continuo con il CTO Locale EU per la gestione integrata del prodotto e del team di sviluppo.
- Progettare, strutturare e scalare il team di sviluppo USA, sfruttando il fuso orario per garantire continuità operativa, velocità di esecuzione e copertura globale, con l’obiettivo di portare il team complessivo oltre +50 figure.
- Collaborare direttamente con il Board C-Level, il TPM e le figure Sub C-Level per tradurre roadmap di business, requisiti commerciali e obiettivi strategici in soluzioni tecnologiche concrete e misurabili.
- Supervisionare architettura, sicurezza, performance, qualità del codice e best practice di sviluppo, mantenendo standard enterprise su ambienti ad alta complessità.
- Guidare processi decisionali tecnologici critici, evitando debito tecnico, inefficienze strutturali e approcci non scalabili.

2. Competenze principali:

- Esperienza comprovata come CTO senior o Head of Engineering in contesti internazionali, tech-driven e ad alta scalabilità.
- Competenza avanzata su stack Java (backend) e React (frontend) in architetture complesse, modulari e ad alte prestazioni.
- Solida esperienza in infrastrutture avanzate, cloud-native, ambienti distribuiti, CI/CD, sicurezza, scalabilità e resilienza dei sistemi.
- Capacità di costruire, guidare e coordinare team di sviluppo internazionali, con forte leadership, governance chiara e processi strutturati.
- Esperienza di lavoro a stretto contatto con TPM, Product, DevOps e Board C-Level, con forte orientamento a KPI, roadmap e time-to-market.
- Visione sistemica, decision-making strategico, capacità di anticipare criticità tecniche e guidare l’evoluzione tecnologica dell’asset nel medio-lungo periodo.

Inglese fluente obbligatorio.
Italiano fluente obbligatorio, sia scritto che parlato, per coordinamento diretto con il team europeo e con parte della governance strategica.

3. Perché dovrei candidarmi a questo ruolo?

- Accesso a un asset operativo già strutturato con capacità di generare impatto immediato senza lunghi cicli di onboarding o setup.
- Infrastruttura con processi già validati e orientati esclusivamente alla produzione di valore economico misurabile.
- Accesso a un database proprietario globale che integra l’intera filiera operativa e commerciale.
- Team R&D composto da senior C-Level con struttura in espansione fino a oltre 50 specialisti.
- Governance centralizzata e decision-making ad alta velocità con supporto diretto del board esecutivo.
- Pipeline di progetti e lanci già definiti e pronti all’esecuzione su scala internazionale.
- Exposure diretta a operazioni ad alto valore economico e modelli di business complessi già attivi.
- Meccanismo di partecipazione economica fino al 40% dei volumi d’affari generati dall’ecosistema R&D.
- Traiettorie di crescita accelerate verso ruoli di leadership operativa e strategica.
- Accesso a un network internazionale di stakeholder, partner industriali e top-tier talent.
- Struttura societaria internazionale basata su modello LLC con governance centralizzata e holding framework.
- Modello operativo remoto-first con autonomia completa, KPI quantitativi e output-based evaluation.

4. Che tipo di contributo mi viene richiesto?

- Consegna puntuale di obiettivi e output secondo scadenze definite, con piena responsabilità sulla qualità e verificabilità dei risultati.
- Utilizzo rigoroso di strumenti e processi operativi, con attenzione alla standardizzazione e alla riduzione delle inefficienze.
- Esecuzione strutturata di iniziative, progetti e task secondo workflow definiti, senza deviazioni non autorizzate dal processo.
- Collaborazione operativa con team senior su attività complesse, garantendo affidabilità e capacità di adattamento.
- Comunicazione chiara, sintetica e orientata all’operatività, con mantenimento della coerenza informativa tra i membri del team.
- Precisione operativa, affidabilità e rispetto delle priorità assegnate, con gestione disciplinata del carico di lavoro.
- Allineamento costante agli obiettivi strategici definiti dal sistema e dai livelli decisionali superiori.
- Applicazione e mantenimento degli standard culturali e operativi dell’organizzazione.
- Approccio orientato all’esecuzione e al risultato, con responsabilità diretta sul contributo individuale.
- Proattività nel miglioramento operativo e nella risoluzione di problemi concreti all’interno del perimetro assegnato.
- Crescita continua delle competenze personali in relazione alle esigenze del sistema e del team.

5. Quali sono i benefici concreti e la partecipazione economica?

- Accesso diretto a mentorship e formazione continua erogata da figure senior e dal Board C-Level, con esposizione a decision-making reale su operazioni ad alto valore.
- Inserimento immediato in un’infrastruttura operativa già attiva, con supporto costante su processi, strumenti e execution layer.
- Coinvolgimento in iniziative B2C e B2B già avviate, con possibilità di contribuire a flussi economici reali e misurabili sin dalle prime fasi.
- Stabilità contrattuale di lungo periodo legata alla continuità di contributo all’ecosistema e alla performance individuale.
- Meccanismo di partecipazione economica fino al 40% dei volumi d’affari generati dall’intero sistema R&D, distribuito su base meritocratica e contributiva.
- Accesso a un modello di valore non lineare: la remunerazione è direttamente proporzionale all’impatto generato sull’asset, non al tempo impiegato.
- Possibilità di crescita economica accelerata in funzione della scalabilità dei risultati prodotti all’interno del sistema.

6. Come funziona la roadmap operativa?

Il modello operativo non richiede il completamento dell’intero MVP per generare valore economico. Le attività sono strutturate per attivare rapidamente flussi di monetizzazione attraverso contributi mirati e progressivi, con un livello di effort contenuto e focalizzato sull’impatto.

- Fase 1 — Attivazione immediata dei flussi commerciali tecnologici (in corso)

L’infrastruttura commerciale è già attiva e supportata da un database proprietario che include tutti gli attori della filiera automotive ad alto valore.
Questo consente l’esecuzione immediata di operazioni su asset reali, riducendo drasticamente attriti burocratici e inefficienze di mercato.
Le componenti tecnologiche sono già integrate nei processi commerciali, permettendo generazione di valore sin dalle fasi iniziali.

- Fase 2 — Scaling B2C e attivazione conversione B2B asset

Il rollout B2C è progettato per attivare flussi di licenze e incremento della base dati, con effetti diretti sulla solidificazione della Sales Community.
La successiva conversione del database B2B consente la trasformazione dell’intero ecosistema in un asset monetizzabile su scala più ampia.

- Fase 3 — Industrializzazione e lancio MVP completo (Release 1)

L’MVP rappresenta la formalizzazione dell’intero sistema multi-channel integrato sulla filiera.
La release abilita operazioni globali scalabili, con processi già validati e ottimizzati per l’esecuzione ad alto volume.
Il contributo del team R&D si traduce direttamente in impatto economico misurabile e partecipazione ai flussi generati.

7. Come candidarsi e cosa aspettarsi dal processo?

Il processo di candidatura è strutturato come funnel di selezione progressivo, progettato per valutare precisione, capacità di esecuzione e allineamento al modello operativo.

La candidatura avviene esclusivamente tramite il processo proprietario, che richiede la compilazione accurata delle informazioni richieste e il caricamento del CV completo di esperienza rilevante.

Ogni candidatura viene valutata in base alla qualità delle risposte e al livello di coerenza con il sistema operativo. Le candidature non conformi o incomplete non vengono prese in considerazione.

I profili selezionati accedono a una fase di screening telefonico iniziale, finalizzata a verificare competenze tecniche, capacità di ragionamento operativo e potenziale contributo all’ecosistema.

Le candidature senior e ad alto impatto vengono prioritizzate per l’accesso rapido alle fasi successive di assessment e definizione contrattuale.
